title: Eclipthar`s Xaero Force Block Mod
description: adds a check with the server to enforce the no minimap/map rule
body:
**_REQUIRES PLUGIN ON SERVER : [CLICK HERE](https://modrinth.com/project/eclipthars-xaero-force-block-plugin)_**

Adds a client-side verification system to enforce the no minimap/map rule by checking the player’s installed modifications and preventing the use of any minimap or map-related features while connected. This helps ensure fair gameplay by disabling unauthorized map functionality and supporting consistent rule compliance across the server.
